fetch.description: Explains why endpoints as structured data eliminates conventional folder sprawl.

data.problem: In conventional client libraries, adding 50 endpoints requires creating 50 directories and 50 repetitive boilerplate files, causing maintenance drag and import fragility.
data.solution: Define endpoints declaratively in JSON contracts (source.json + api.json) and assemble the callable object tree in memory at startup.
benefits: Single point of query customization in engine/execution
Instant in-memory object tree generation without code duplication
Deterministic compile-time TypeScript typing directly from JSON

fetch.description: Details the three clean architectural layers of a JSON-driven NPM package.

layers.name: 1. Public Contract (api.json)
layers.role: Explicit array of allowed dot-separated paths controlling the public perimeter.

layers.name: 2. Domain Specification (source.json)
layers.role: Single source of truth for resources, actions, schemas, JSDocs, and mock or real payloads.

layers.name: 3. Engine (engine/)
layers.role: In-memory route tree assembly (engine/route/) and story-driven execution pipeline (engine/execution/).

fetch.description: Specification for json-driven-npm: The Architectural Source of Truth.

data.role: Architectural Source of Truth & Reference Specification
responsibilities: Maintains reference versions (v1, v2, v3, v4)
Provides the in-memory route mounting engine
Exposes live CLI terminal inspector via npx json-driven-npm
data.rule: Never transports code itself; acts as the authoritative template source.

fetch.description: Specification for create-json-driven-npm: The Zero-Dependency Code Transporter.

data.usage: npm create json-driven-npm [target-directory] or npx create-json-driven-npm [target-directory]
data.mechanism: Dynamically inspects node_modules/json-driven-npm/src, resolves the highest active version, and transports the clean skeleton into the target directory.

fetch.description: Specification for create-intellisense: The Automated TypeScript Generator.

data.mechanism: Scans api.json and source.json in the project root or active version folder and emits index.d.ts with full IDE autocomplete and hover tooltips.
features: Flexible path discovery (supports flattened and nested layouts)
Auto-infers types from package.json and active exports

fetch.description: The 3-step development guide for creating a new JSON-driven NPM package.

steps.name: Scaffold
steps.description: create-json-driven-npm transports the clean v4 skeleton into your project directory with zero dependencies.

steps.name: Customize
steps.description: Define your public routes in api.json and endpoint metadata in source.json. Implement your custom query/fetch logic in engine/execution/index.js.

steps.name: Generate Types
steps.description: create-intellisense scans your JSON contracts and emits index.d.ts, giving your users instant autocomplete and type safety.

fetch.description: Core KeshavSoft engineering standards and design conventions.

standards.rationale: Eliminates named export clutter and namespace ambiguity.

standards.syntax: const startFunc = ({ inParam }) => { const localParam = inParam; ... };
standards.rationale: Prevents mutation of input objects and makes parameter origins explicit.
Keeps domain specifications independent from network protocols, headers, or runtime environments.
